To the right of the refrigerator, there is a countertop with a few items on it, including a couple of travel mugs and a utensil holder with various kitchen tools. Below the countertop, there is a white dishwasher. Next to the dishwasher, there is a sink with a bottle of distilled water and some sponges on the counter. The floor is covered with light-colored tiles.
